title: Pay the Minimum on $5,000? That's 19 Years #shorts
description:
Pay only the minimum on a $5,000 credit card and it takes about 19 years to pay off, with about $7,782 in interest. Pay $200 a month instead: under 3 years and about $1,655 in interest.

Why: your first minimum payment is about $138, and about $88 of it (64%) is just interest.

Math: $5,000 balance at 21.19%, the average credit card rate on accounts charged interest (Federal Reserve G.19). Minimum = interest + 1% of the balance, with a $25 floor: a formula many card agreements use (check your own card agreement; issuers differ). Monthly compounding, no new purchases or fees. Under the CARD Act (2009), statements must show how long paying only the minimum takes.

Watch next: Same $200 a month, double the money https://youtu.be/-PHcrZzxjjw

This video is for education only and is not financial advice.
